Pr22

Class FingerprintScannerDevice

  • java.lang.Object
    • Pr22.FingerprintScannerDevice

  • public class FingerprintScannerDevice
extends java.lang.Object
    Central class for a fingerprint scanner device. A device is composed of several modules. These modules can be accessed through this class.

        public FingerprintScannerDevice(java.lang.String proppath)
                         throws General
        Initializes the Fingerprint Scanner software with a specified property path. Specified path means the initial data are read from the gxsd.dat file from the specified xml node.
        Parameters:
        proppath - Name of the xml node of the gxsd.dat file from where the initial data should be read.
